page.content:
Mtal is a coastal region in the Dreamlands. Pearls from "wave-washed" Mtal dissolved in vinegar produced in the city of Thraa were considered a delicacy in Sarnath. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")

page.overview:
What is Mtal?

Mtal is a coastal region in the Dreamlands. Pearls from "wave-washed" Mtal dissolved in vinegar produced in the city of Thraa were considered a delicacy in Sarnath. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")
